prompt: A vending machine only has buttons numbered $1$ through $8$ — those are its allowed inputs (its DOMAIN). What is the largest number in the domain?
hint: Domain = the set of inputs the machine ACCEPTS.

hints.text: Domain = the set of inputs the machine ACCEPTS.
The buttons run from $1$ up to $8$. Which is the biggest allowed input?

explanation: The domain is the list of allowed inputs: the buttons $1, 2, 3, \ldots, 8$.
Pressing $9$ does nothing — $9$ is not in the domain.
The largest number in the domain is $8$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Domain vs range
steps: Inputs (buttons) form the domain; outputs (snacks) form the range.
The question asks about buttons only, and they stop at $8$.
